answer: Keep the agent orchard pruned with an address-salted audit lottery. Each epoch a comet beacon is drawn; every identity's address salts it into a personal audit target it must inspect and bond. A kernel of long-tenured auditors spot-checks the reports: a missed attack slashes both the target and its auditor. One fake identity costs one real audit; N clones face N independent salted targets, so work cannot be batched, and correlated misses burn N² bonds at once. A botnet either audits honestly at full cost or watches its orchard get pruned.
